# Porządkowanie i czyszczenie danych

## Braki danych 

```{r}
vis_miss(dane, warn_large_data = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gg_miss_fct(dane, fct = gender) #rozkładam na czynniki pierwsze
```

```{r}
gg_miss_upset(dane, nsets = 10) #zmniejszam liczbę zestawów do 10, żeby wykres był czytelniejszy
```

Założenia:
-> age: większe niż 0 mniejsze niż 25
-> gender: kobiety, mężczyźni, inni
-> education level: podstawówki, liceum
-> school type: 
-> previus exam score: od 0 do 100
-> poprzednie średnie: od 1 do 4 (są NA)
-> attendance -> od 0 do 100%
-> assignement completion -> od 0 do 100%
-> study hours -> od 0 do 24 h
-> self study -> od 0 do 24h
-> nauka online -> od 0 do 24h 
-> practise test completed -> od 0 
-> godziny snu -> od 0 do 15 h
-> daily screen time -> od 0 do 24h
-> physical activity hours -> od 0 do 24h
-> online course hours -> od 0 do 24 h
-> exam preparation days -> od 0 do 40 
-> questions atempted -> od 0 do 100
-> question correct -> od 0 do 100
-> time management -> od 0 do 100
-> exam anxiety level -> 1 do 10
-> exam score -> od 0 do 100% .

```{r}
library(validate)
library(validatetools)
library(dcmodify)
library(errorlocate)
```

```{r}
rules <- validator(
  age >= 0 & age <= 25,
  previous_exam_score >= 0 & previous_exam_score <= 100,
  previous_average >= 1 & previous_average <= 4,
  attendance >= 0 & attendance <= 100,
  assignment_completion >= 0 & assignment_completion <= 100,
  study_hours >= 0 & study_hours <= 24,
  self_study >= 0 & self_study <= 24,
  online_learning >= 0 & online_learning <= 24,
  practice_test_completed >= 0,
  sleep_hours >= 0 & sleep_hours <= 15,
  daily_screen_time >= 0 & daily_screen_time <= 24,
  physical_activity_hours >= 0 & physical_activity_hours <= 24,
  online_course_hours >= 0 & online_course_hours <= 24,
  exam_preparation_days >= 0 & exam_preparation_days <= 40,
  questions_attempted >= 0 & questions_attempted <= 100,
  questions_correct >= 0 & questions_correct <= 100,
  time_management >= 0 & time_management <= 100,
  exam_anxiety_level >= 1 & exam_anxiety_level <= 10,
  exam_score >= 0 & exam_score <= 100
)
```
